notes: Needs and moods: characters get hungry, tired and stressed over the day (work stresses them, free time and sleep calm them down), and their mood changes with what happens. It shows on their card and drives how they act.
Boredom: doing the same thing over and over gets old. Characters notice when their routine repeats a lot.

Wardrobes: everyone has their own clothes (made from their sheet if you didn't write any) and changes on their own for work, sleep, the gym or a formal event. The story can buy, return and change clothes too.
Your bag: the story keeps track of what you pick up, receive or lose.
See and edit clothes and your bag in 📅 Events → Clothes & bag. The creator has a Wardrobe box with a ✨ suggest button.
